summary: This bill requires the Bureau of Prisons to employ at least one full-time, board-certified obstetrician-gynecologist at each facility housing female prisoners to provide comprehensive women's health services, including initial visits within 14 days of imprisonment, and mandates annual reports to Congress on compliance and related health outcomes.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates improved healthcare access for female prisoners, specifically obstetrician-gynecologist services. This represents a move towards more humane treatment and rehabilitation within the prison system, aligning with softer justice principles by focusing on the well-being of incarcerated individuals.
